name: oneday stats
description: Paired tests for subjects measured under several conditions in one acquisition: paired Wilcoxon signed-rank of each condition against a reference condition, and the Friedman test across all conditions, each Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted. One test per row x column cell; colors: condition; labels: subject (pairing unit); y: the value (e.g. proportion). Same layout as the Wilcoxon Test operator.

properties.name: reference_condition
properties.description: Condition every other condition is compared with (e.g. DMSO, BL). Required for the paired tests.

properties.name: alpha
properties.description: Adjusted p-value below which a row is marked significant.
